title: The phone app's icon when themed icons are on

steps.path: Your phone's home screen, with themed icons switched on
steps.headline: Which icon should the phone show when themed icons are on?
steps.notice: Android draws each app in one colour when themed icons are on, and flips that colour between dark and light home screens. Each picture shows both.
steps.risk: Only the themed look changes. With themed icons off, everyone keeps the full-colour icon.

variants.label: Today's outline face
variants.summary: A hollow face outline. Looks right on a light home screen; on a dark one the eyes turn into pale blobs with tiny dots — the staring look you saw.
variants.risk: Stays the scary-looking one on dark home screens.

variants.label: Solid face
variants.summary: A filled face with the eyes and mouth cut out. On a dark home screen it reads like the real icon: soft face, dark eyes, white sparkles. On a light one Android flips it to a dark face with pale eyes.
variants.risk: Flips the other way on light home screens.

variants.label: Always the real icon
variants.summary: No one-colour version at all: the phone shows the same full-colour icon as the desktop, whatever the home screen. It stands out from apps that do follow the theme.
variants.risk: Newer Android versions may tint it anyway to match the theme; I could not confirm which ones do.
